git.enableHint: Branches and pull requests that contain an issue key are linked automatically.
git.connectionHint: Connect a repository from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, or Bitbucket.
git.webhookEndpointHint: One endpoint receives branch, pull request, and CI updates from every connected repository.
git.secretRegenerated: New secret created. Cập nhật it in your repository webhook too.
git.hintGithub: Repository Cài đặt → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above, set the content type to application/json, then select Pull requests, Check runs, and branch Tạo/Xóa events.
git.hintGitlab: Dự án Cài đặt → Webhooks → Add new webhook. Paste the URL, put the secret in Secret token, and enable Merge request, Pipeline, and Push events.
git.hintGitea: Repository Cài đặt → Webhooks → Add webhook, type Gitea (Forgejo on Forgejo). Paste both values above and enable pull request plus branch tạo/xóa events.
git.hintBitbucket: Repository Cài đặt → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above and select pull request plus branch created/deleted events.

git.commandCopied: Command copied. Replace owner/repo, then run it.

nativeTokenHint.github: Use a fine-grained token with Metadata read, Webhooks write, and Pull requests write access for the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.gitlab: Use a personal access token with API access. Only dự án where you are a Maintainer or Owner are listed.
nativeTokenHint.gitea: Use an access token that can administer hooks in the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.forgejo: Use an access token that can administer hooks in the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.bitbucket: Use a Bitbucket Cloud access token that can read your user, workspaces, and repositories, administer repository webhooks, and bình luận on pull requests.
